messages.text:
Hey HeliumDeploy team,

My partner Aleksandar is starting a Youtube series called Best Ad W..

I saw an ad of HeliumDeploy and thought you'd be good to have on.

Would you like to be a guest for an episode?

P.S. You'll get the clips for your own use, and for coming on we'll also make you a complimentary video ad of one of your products.

Cheers,
Jordan

--

Jordan W.
Partner | Carbon Box Media
Handed to the team · Media/partnership invitation, only the team can decide; nothing promised.

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for thinking of us for Best Ad W.. Glad our ad caught your eye.

Whether we can come on as a guest is a call for the people who run HeliumDeploy, so I've passed your invitation to them. That includes the clips for our own use and the complimentary video ad. A colleague will pick it up today and reply to you in this thread.

If you have dates, an episode format or a link to Aleksandar's channel, just reply here. It'll help them decide faster.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Thanks, Sarah.

For the rest of the team, I'm Jordan, a partner at Carbon Box Media. We're
starting a YouTube series called Best Ad W., where an ecommerce founder brings
the best ad they've run and we talk about why it worked.

It's 30 minutes online, about 20 of it on camera, with nothing to prep beyond
the ad. You keep the recording and the clips, and we make a new video ad for one
of your products, all on us.

The Best Ad W. page [https://podcast.advertisable.ai/] shows how an episode
goes and some real ads we've made, so it's an easy way to see what you'd walk
away with.

Best,
Jordan

--

Jordan W.
Partner | Carbon Box Media

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the extra details. They're with the team along with your first message, so they have the whole picture: the 30-minute online format with about 20 minutes on camera, the founder bringing their best ad, and the recording, clips and new product video ad on your side. They also have the link to the Best Ad W. page so they can see a sample episode.

Whether we take part is their call. A colleague will pick it up today and reply to you here in this thread.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

handoffs: Media/partnership invitation, only the team can decide; nothing promised.
